annotations.title: chainpeek: find the block at a point in time

description: chainpeek: find the block at a point in time on Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For the latest block use get_block_number. Returns `block` (the last block at or before the time) and `next_block`, or `is_latest: true` when the time is at or after the head. A time before Base's genesis is a 422 before_genesis (not charged). A malformed or inconsistent node answer is a 5xx and is not charged. Typically 1-3 s (about 3-6 reads). Price: USD 0.003. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/block-at-timestamp-api.html

timestamp.description: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 (no offset = UTC), e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

name: get_block_at_time

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
